decision.message: The request is supported using the esp32_sht31_v1 family with the standard 100 kHz I2C profile and normal operating limits (3.2–3.4 V supply, 10–35 °C ambient, 4.7k pull-ups, 50–70 pF bus capacitance). Heater control as described is a firmware behavior, which is compatible with the hardware configuration.

clauses.text: Create an SHT31 controller using the normal supported electrical limits.
clauses.reason: Request specifies SHT31 controller using normal electrical limits, heater off at startup and on during humidity measurement — all within supported capabilities of esp32_sht31_v1 family.

clauses.text: Keep its heater off at startup, but run the heater continuously while taking normal humidity measurements.
clauses.reason: Heater control behavior described is supported by firmware choices; heater off at startup and on during humidity measurement is feasible and allowed.
